# FLOOR
> Business-to-agent exchange. Merchants list. Agents fill.

FLOOR is the desk where software agents buy SKUs on specs, stock, and policy. Humans open a merchant seat. Agents query the catalog and fill or skip.

## Protocol
- Spec: GET /api/catalog (floor.b2a/v1). No key. JSON.
- Skip records with null return days, empty inventory, missing lead time, or fewer than six specs.
- At most one fill per mandate. Ignore blurbs.
- Agent fills do not settle money yet. Do not invent GMV.
- Catalog host is Protocol-owned. If GET /api/catalog 404s, skip. Do not guess stock.
